MATTRESS_DEPTH_MM.doc: Queen mattress width, laid across the van. The east-west bedroom's depth from the nose; fixed. Bedroom 1 measures 1570.

MATTRESS_QUEEN_LENGTH_MM.doc: Queen mattress length. Below this the layout warns: the van is too narrow for a queen mattress across it. Bedroom 1: 2275 − 395 = 1880.

BODY_DEPTH_MM.doc: Boot and wardrobe depth from the nose. The mattress continues past this into the room. Bedroom 1 measures 756.

BOOT_HEIGHT_MM.doc: Boot deck top above the floor. Bedroom 1 measures 400 → 418.

WARDROBE_MIN_MM.doc: Narrowest wardrobe. Same minimum as the north-south wardrobe.

OHC_BOTTOM_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Overhead door underside above the floor when the params give none. Bedroom 1 measures 1418 (doors 1418 → 1738).

OHC_ZONE_COUNT_DEFAULT.doc: Up-flap bays across the overhead when the params give none. Bedroom 1 has three. Two or three are allowed.

OHC_ZONE_MIN_MM.doc: Narrowest overhead bay, centreline to centreline. Same as the north-south overhead.

OPENING_HEIGHT_MIN_MM.doc: Least clear height between the boot deck and the overhead underside. Same as the north-south bedroom.

OHC_HEIGHT_MIN_MM.doc: Least overhead height under the roof at the body's room face. Same as the north-south bedroom.
